physicalNotes: Radius 1.528 Jupiter radii from Gillon et al. 2014 (2014A&A...562L...3G), via the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2014A%26A...562L...3G/abstract): 109,239.8 km at 71,492 km per Jupiter radius. GM from the mass 1.49 Jupiter masses (Gillon et al. 2014, the mass the NASA Exoplanet Archive's composite table adopts (2014A&A...562L...3G), via the NASA Exoplanet Archive, https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2014A%26A...562L...3G/abstract) times JPL's Jupiter GM. The spherical geometry belongs to the selected SPARC/MITgcm model. The separate CHEOPS tidal-deformation inference is not transferred onto this model.
